# Xml.Document

```m
Xml.Document(contents as any, optional encoding as nullable number) as table
```

Returns the contents of the XML document as a hierarchical table.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `contents` | `any` | no |
| `encoding` | `nullable number` | yes |
